descs.en: He blew open a shipping container expecting contraband and found a princess. She refused to go home, and kept turning up at his safe houses.

ideaNote: Planned: 50 chapters. The Container · The Ring · The Throne · The Address · Side stories.

synopsis.title: Synopsis
synopsis.content:
Evangeline Lin has spent her whole life as somebody’s secret. Born to a foreign throne and hidden by Lin Jian as his son’s “paper twin”, she was raised to be useful, not loved. When her name leaks, traffickers take her, and the man who blows the lock on her container isn’t there to save anyone. Lee Jun Hyuk came for the official on the manifest. He offers her a gun and a way out, and expects never to see her again.

She won’t go home. She finds his safe houses, one after another, and sits in them without asking for anything, until the night he comes back with a wound that won’t close and finds her changing his bandages as if she has always done it.

authorNote.title: Author Note
authorNote.content:
This is the quietest book in the series, and I think it will be the most tender. Two people who have never had a home make one in the most dangerous places they can find: a borderland flat, a room over a garage, a cabin with the windows boarded.

Evangeline barely speaks in the other books. I wanted to know what she’d say if somebody waited long enough. Jun Hyuk is a hard man and the book won’t pretend otherwise. But he touches her as if he’s checking she’s real, and she is always the one who decides when.

contentWarn.title: Content Warning
contentWarn.content:
This will be a dark romance. Planned content includes:

• Human trafficking (shipping containers and what happens inside them), written with care and not as spectacle

• Violence and killing by the hero, mostly off the page

• A serious wound, infection and fever

• A parent who treats a daughter as an asset, and a knife held to his throat
